whyItMatters: Without frame-ancestors, any site can frame the page and run clickjacking attacks against authenticated users.
actions: Add frame-ancestors 'self' to the Content-Security-Policy (use 'none' if the page must never be framed).
Keep X-Frame-Options during migration for older browsers.
Verify the header on authenticated and anonymous responses, including error pages.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and framing from a foreign origin is refused.
